description: This file contains the source code for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, which is a jQuery-based plugin for enhancing select boxes with support for searching, tagging, remote data sets, infinite scrolling, and many other highly used features. The file includes module definitions, utility functions, and component implementations such as results rendering, selection handling, event relaying, and translations.

classes.name: Results
classes.description: Manages rendering, updating, and interaction with the dropdown result list.

classes.name: BaseSelection
classes.description: Base class for handling the selection component of select2, providing common rendering and event handling logic.

classes.name: SingleSelection
classes.description: Handles the rendering and management of a single selected item.

classes.name: MultipleSelection
classes.description: Handles the rendering and management of multiple selected items.

classes.name: Placeholder
classes.description: Decorator class that adds placeholder support to the selection component.

classes.name: AllowClear
classes.description: Decorator class that adds an 'allow clear' functionality to clear the selection.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Decorator class that adds inline search input into the selection component.

classes.name: EventRelay
classes.description: Relays select2 internal events to trigger corresponding events on the main element.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Handles translations and loading translation data for internationalization.

classes.name: Diacritics
classes.description: Provides a list of diacritic character mappings for accent-insensitive search.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main DOM element for the Results component.

methods.name: displayMessage
methods.description: Displays a message in the results list, such as 'No results found.'

methods.name: hideMessages
methods.description: Removes any message elements from the results list.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a list of data items as options to the results list.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Positions the results list relative to the dropdown container.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the result data based on the configured sorter.

methods.name: highlightFirstItem
methods.description: Highlights the first result item, or a selected item if present.

methods.name: setClasses
methods.description: Updates the CSS classes for result options based on selection state.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message while fetching results.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Creates a DOM element for a result option.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds event handlers to the Results component.

methods.name: getHighlightedResults
methods.description: Returns the currently highlighted result options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the Results component and removes its DOM elements.

methods.name: ensureHighlightVisible
methods.description: Ensures that the highlighted result is visible in the scrollable list.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Applies the result template to a result item.
